# Course overview
Robotics Foundation is an 8-week course for Grades 6 to 8. Students assemble the robotics kit and program it with blocks to move, avoid obstacles and follow lines. The course builds from simple motion to a final maze challenge.

# What you will learn
You will learn how a robot moves with two motors, how to turn accurately, how to use the distance sensor to stop before a wall, how to use the line sensor to follow a black line, and how to combine loops and conditions into a complete program.

# Modules and lessons
Module 1 is Meet Your Robot with Lesson 1. Module 2 is Move and Turn with Lesson 2, where you draw a square. Module 3 is Sense the Distance with Lesson 3, where you build the Wall Stopper. Module 4 is Follow the Line with Lesson 4, where you build the Line Follower. Module 5 is the Obstacle Course. Module 6 is the final challenge, Maze Runner.

# Kit you need
The Robotics Foundation kit: robot controller, two drive motors with wheels, distance sensor, line sensor, battery pack and chassis frame. If you have no kit, use the Simulator robot.

# How you are assessed
Each lesson ends with a two-question quiz. You pass the course when you complete at least 80 percent of the lessons and finish the Maze Runner challenge. The challenge rubric gives points for reaching the end, not touching walls and a clean, well-organised program.
